title: Emerging leaders in materials science: Capturing key advances in materials innovation
abstract: <jats:p>Materials science continues to play a crucial role in addressing critical challenges in technology and society, driving advancements that span a wide range of industries. The development of new materials, combined with advanced characterization techniques and data-driven approaches, is fundamental to unlocking new possibilities in fields such as electronics, energy, and beyond. This collection highlights the inspiring work of emerging leaders in materials science, presenting their innovative research across a wide array of topics, spanning materials synthesis, characterization, and applications in fields such as optics, magnetics, electronics, energy, and biomaterials.</jats:p>
